process.commandLine: bash -c 'set -u; if ! getent hosts "{{PROXY_HOST}}" >/dev/null; then echo PIN_MISSING; exit 1; fi; echo PIN_PRESENT_OK; if ! curl -fsSL --max-time 15 http://mxc-test.invalid/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q MXC_TEST_ORIGIN_OK; then echo PIN_PROXY_UNREACHABLE; exit 1; fi; echo PIN_PROXY_OK; timeout 6 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/10.0.2.2/{{CONTROL_PORT}}" >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" = 0 ]; then echo PIN_DIRECT_EGRESS_LEAKED; exit 1; fi; echo PIN_DIRECT_BLOCKED_OK'
